content: The wise person learns from everyone, respects all perspectives, and abides unshakeably in core truth.
author: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
explanation:
Bridging Eastern metaphysics and Western reason, Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan articulates how spiritual intuition elevates human intellect and fosters universal brotherhood.

This passage emphasizes the vital importance of wise and person in human life. By moving beyond superficial distractions and grounding attention in timeless ethical principles, we cultivate inner stability, clarity of thought, and genuine resilience.

True realization is never an abstract academic debate—it is an active discipline practiced through conscious daily choices and unwavering integrity.
